---
name: Theme or scenery idea
about: Suggest a palette or a scene
labels: enhancement
---

**The idea** — name it, and describe the mood in a line.

**Reference** — a photo, a screenshot, an existing theme. Something to aim at
beats an adjective.

**Light or dark?**

**Accent** — what should buttons and links be? On a grey theme, a warm accent
usually reads better than another grey.

Note: scenery has to clear 7:1 against body text, because article copy sits
directly on it. Bold silhouettes will come back as pale watermarks.
